M01_tick_ack_before_watchdog.description: Tick: the ack timeout is evaluated BEFORE the watchdog (order of the two if-arms swapped)

M02_advance_term_no_ramp.description: Advance into Termination forgets to ramp the units down

M03_advance_term_deenergize.description: Advance into Termination de-energizes (Off) instead of ramping

M04_soft_stop_deenergize.description: a soft stop (JTT/RTPS) trips the units to Off instead of ramping them down

M05_heatoff_clears_inhibit.description: HeatOff on an Inhibited unit clears the local inhibit

M06_dms_arms_on_second_demand.description: the DMS arms on the SECOND PTN demand (guard 'level already LPtn')

M07_plasma_true_clears_stop.description: Plasma{True} clears a soft stop (level back to LNone)

M08_plasma_true_rearms_heat.description: Plasma{True} puts a Ramping unit back to On

M09_stop_lnone_resets_hb.description: a Stop{LNone} (no-response alarm) is treated as proof of life: resets hb

M10_advance_resets_hb.description: Advance resets the heartbeat counter ('the sequencer is alive')

M12_reset_rejects_fired.description: the reset guard also refuses when the DMS has Fired (stricter)

M13_reset_accepts_term_armed.description: the reset guard accepts Termination even with the DMS Armed

M14_counters_swapped.description: the hb and t_ack command functions are wired to the wrong counters

M15_ack_max_off_by_one.description: bt = t_ack+1 <= ack_max (off-by-one in the ack timeout)

M16_hb_verdict_off_by_one_other_way.description: bh = hb < hb_max (watchdog verdict reads the old count)

M17_concretize_mchs_as_slow.description: concretize: the MCHS trigger reads the SLOW column

M18_concretize_dhs_as_mchs.description: concretize: the DHS trigger reads the MCHS column

M19_concretize_heaton_to_heatoff.description: concretize: XHeatOn is wired to the abstract HeatOff

M20_concretize_tick_arms_dms.description: concretize: XTick carries dms=True (dms_on_watchdog silently on)

M24_rtps_jumps_to_termination.description: an RTPS stop also forces phase := Termination (the JTT rule applied too widely)

M25_heatack_never_fires.description: HeatAck does not fire the DMS (only the timeout does)

M26_stop_ptn_without_dms_is_noop.description: Stop{LPtn, False} is the identity: PTN latches only when the stop is wired to the DMS

M27_watchdog_never_latches_ptn.description: the heartbeat watchdog never latches PTN; hb simply stops counting

M28_plasma_false_keeps_flag.description: Plasma{False} de-energizes but leaves plasma_ok True

M30_commfault_ignores_dms_flag.description: CommFault never arms the DMS (the dms payload is dropped)

M31_ptn_clears_inhibit.description: to_ptn on a PTN stop drives both units to Off, clearing a local inhibit

M32_tack_counts_while_idle.description: t_ack increments on every Tick even with the DMS Idle

M33_dms_arms_on_second_demand_v2.description: the DMS arms only if the PTN was already latched before the stop (second demand)

M34_watchdog_acts_only_if_wired_to_dms.description: the watchdog latches PTN only when dms_on_watchdog is set; in BOTH certified instances it does nothing

M35_soft_stop_is_noop.description: a JTT/RTPS stop request is the identity (only PTN is implemented)

M36_heatack_fires_from_idle.description: HeatAck fires the DMS even when it was never armed

M37_no_rearm_after_commfault_ptn.description: a DMS-wired PTN stop arriving when PTN is already latched does nothing (rule 1 parenthetical dropped)

N01_advance_nonheat_keeps_power.description: Advance into a non-heating phase no longer de-energizes the units

N02_hb_counts_ignoring_verdict.description: upd_hb increments on every Tick outside PTN, the bh verdict is not read

N03_tack_counts_while_fired.description: t_ack keeps counting once the DMS has Fired (dms != Idle instead of == Armed)

N04_heartbeat_ignored_under_ptn.description: a heartbeat does not reset the watchdog counter once the PTN is latched

N05_concretize_against_next_phase.description: step_c reads the alarm matrix at the phase the sequencer is entering

N06_concrete_layer_order2.description: both instances run the abstract step with urgency order 2

N07_concrete_layer_ignores_instance.description: step_c always uses instance 1's alarm matrix

N08_plasma_loss_inhibits.description: loss of plasma latches the units Inhibited instead of de-energizing them

N09_heaton_needs_healthy_watchdog.description: HeatOn is refused whenever the watchdog verdict bh is false

N10_commfault_dropped_when_hb_late.description: CommFault{False} is ignored while the watchdog verdict bh is false

N11_advance_restarts_ack_timer.description: Advance restarts t_ack while the DMS is Idle

N12_stop_lnone_restarts_ack_timer.description: a Stop{LNone} restarts t_ack while the DMS is Idle

N13_instance2_window_off_by_one.description: instance 2's MHD override starts at Heating1 instead of Xpoint

N14_dms_req_ignores_phase_window.description: dms_req drops the phase window: FAST/MHD arm the DMS in every phase

N15_arm_goes_straight_to_fired.description: arming the DMS sets DmsFired directly

N16_ptn_deenergizes_nb_only.description: to_ptn de-energizes the neutral beam and forgets the RF

N17_heatack_also_latches_ptn.description: the heating acknowledgement also latches the PTN and trips the units

N18_heartbeat_restarts_ack_timer.description: a heartbeat also restarts the DMS acknowledgement timer

N19_plasma_true_resets_hb.description: Plasma{True} is treated as proof of life and resets the watchdog

N20_arms_now_drops_idle_test.description: arms_now returns the payload alone, so a repeat demand restarts t_ack

N21_counter_limits_swapped.description: the verdicts read hb against ack_max and t_ack against hb_max

N22_stop_accept_ge.description: the stop acceptance test is >= instead of > (a repeat request re-runs the ramp)

N23_accept_hardwired_order1.description: the acceptance comparison is hard-wired to urgency order 1

N24_watchdog_ignores_latched_ptn.description: the watchdog branch runs even when the PTN is already latched, pre-empting the ack timeout

N25_reset_keeps_phase.description: an accepted end of pulse clears the responses but leaves the phase where it was

M63_hb_max_4.description: HB_MAX = 4: the watchdog tolerates one missed heartbeat more than A-11 allows

M64_ack_max_3.description: ACK_MAX = 3: the acknowledgement timeout is one tick later than A-13 allows

M65_init_plasma_true.description: the initial state has plasma_ok = True (R-5: no plasma at Breakdown)

M66_init_iprise.description: the initial phase is IpRise instead of Breakdown

M67_heat_win_xpoint.description: the heating window also admits Xpoint (A-6: Heating1 and Heating2 only)

M68_dms_window_no_term.description: the DMS arming window drops Termination (R-13 / [S6] include it)

M69_rank2_jtt_ge_rtps.description: urgency order 2 ranks JTT and RTPS equal (a tie: neither pre-empts the other)

M70_heatack_ignored_in_term.description: the concrete layer drops XHeatAck while the phase is Termination

M71_reset_fired_needs_plasma_false.description: the end of pulse with the DMS Fired is accepted only once the plasma is gone

M72_inv_all_hb_le.description: the MODEL invariant reads hb <= HB_MAX instead of hb < HB_MAX (the oracle side is what is mutated)

M73_table_one_cell.description: one wrong cell in the alarm matrix (instance 1, Xpoint, Slow: RTPS for PTN), concretize wired correctly
